body:
PR114's unrestricted B3 threshold run spent 1800 seconds with an incomplete root. This change implements a sequential exact Benders formulation for the same joint MESS route/mode/P/Q/SOC/grid problem. It preserves all 1,533 inherited tracked files and starts from exact head `964b2c65964ff38089dab53c4e2fa03149d729f7`.

Full original M1 places all 208,312 binaries in the master; the diagnostic B3 partition places 85,744 binaries there and keeps outside binaries continuous. Canonical recourse preserves every original row, both equality directions and finite bounds. Feasibility and P1 optimality cut derivations were committed before cut code. Exact rational bound compensation and outward rounding certify cuts on the stored coefficients; a separate checker verifies their global affine direction. The reusable M-stage adapter takes explicit anchor/state, accepts M1 values as Start hints, and binds P2's inherited `1e-7` P1 lock to its anchor/state context. P2 retains movement energy then movement count.

All 1,536 assignments across 12 bounded physical fixtures match native/canonical LP feasibility and monolithic/Benders P1 optima. Every feasible assignment survives the cuts, every infeasible assignment is excluded, and adversarial sign/bound/B/RHS/near-zero checks reject altered certificates. Actual solver matrix audits preserve all96 physics, PCS16, terminal SOC, voltage and transformer rows.

The real B3 experiment is **INCONCLUSIVE**. Its first master solved in 0.012 seconds; the first recourse LP returned INFEASIBLE after 1433.581 seconds with a very-big-Kappa warning (`5.11554e15`). The Farkas ray failed strict multiplier-sign verification, so the engine stopped before adding any cut. One candidate's infeasibility is not a global B3 proof. There is no validated witness, zero feasibility/optimality cuts, and the canary gate failed. Full M1 canary/production/P2 and A2/M2 production were not run; P1/M1/Problem13 acceptance remain false. Original UB `0.5912812634331275`, valid global LB `0.5722125039436496`, gap `3.224989640084286%` are unchanged.

The exact executed V1 source and raw logs are archived. V1 did not serialize the rejected ray vector/hash/magnitude; this diagnostic limitation is explicit. Published code now archives terminal certificate inputs before verification. There was no additional real optimization after STOP. The 64-question Korean review, non-run gate results, warning/resource receipts and SHA256 manifests are under `docs/v42_mess_exact_benders/`.

Validation: **708 tests pass** (643 inherited + 65 new), with one inherited log1p warning. Inherited 44 bounded-check receipts and all tracked bytes are preserved. `git diff --check` passes. No performance speedup or full-scale solver acceptance is claimed.
title: Implement exact joint MESS Benders and stop B3 on uncertified Farkas ray
